text: Here’s hoping we see your bike painted white this year.
name: Rob Mackenzie

text: Next time I’ll run you over.
name: Black Volkswagen (Ontario CALE 064)

text: You don’t have an engine. You aren’t allowed in the middle of the road you dumb cunt.
name: Black Volkswagen (Ontario CALE 064)

text: Cycling helped me lose over 40 lbs in the summer.
name: Brian Erdelyi

text: I don’t own a car and cycle to work
name: Anonymous

text: With our plan, everyone will be able to get around by bicycle safely and conveniently.
name: Jagmeet Singh, Leader of the New Democratic Party (NDP)

text: I’ve ridden many times with you Olivia, but today, on the first official day of you being sworn in as mayor is the most exciting ride I’ve ever had with you.
name: Paula Fletcher, Toronto City Councillor

text: I feel so blessed to be able to come to work on my first day of being the mayor of this great city of ours with hundreds of cyclists. I was also picturing, if all of us were in a car, there’d be serious traffic problems.
name: Olivia Chow, Mayor of Toronto

text: And you can ride year round.
name: Olivia Chow, Mayor of Toronto

text: Let me share with you what I wear cycling in the wintertime. Warm gloves, warm socks… good wool socks, and an outer layer that can block some wind.
name: Olivia Chow, Mayor of Toronto

text: We need to and will remove and replace existing bike lanes on primary roads that are bringing traffic in our cities to a standstill.
name: Doug Ford, Premier of Ontario

text: Put them on the secondary roads and let the main arterial roads flow with the traffic.
name: Doug Ford, Premier of Ontario

text: I can speak for Etobicoke folks there – they despise these bike lanes.
name: Doug Ford, Premier of Ontario
